reuse.why: Introduces one shared applyWeekendRule in shared/schedules.ts built on the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and routes getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, the new getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts through it.

duplication.why: The skip-or-move decision exists once; the only repetition is schedule-template.ts evaluating applyWeekendRule twice per occurrence through two small closures.

placement.why: Day classification and the frequency-dependent rule live in the shared schedules module that server and template code already import, and the handler sits next to getUpcomingDates.

scope.why: Focused on schedule date resolution; it also renames the rule data key weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode (consistently, at its only reader), a small incidental change.

maintainability.why: A change to weekend or holiday handling now touches one function with a typed config input; look-ahead and shift windows are named constants.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; the daily case is one branch in the new shared applyWeekendRule, which every caller uses
